# FastTest

> > FastTest is a comprehensive internet speed testing platform that measures and compares ISP performance across different networks and connection types.

FastTest provides users with detailed network diagnostics and performance metrics, helping them understand their internet speed across various ISPs and connection methods. The platform leverages modern web technologies to deliver accurate speed testing with support for multiple browsers and network types.

## Key Topics

- Internet Speed Testing
- ISP Comparison
- Network Performance
- Ethernet vs WiFi
- Connection Optimization
- Network Diagnostics
- Speed Factors
- Google Fiber
- Xfinity
- Real-time Testing
- Browser Compatibility
- CDN Performance

## Speed Testing

- [FastTest](https://afasttest.com): Internet speed test tool comparing ISP performance across networks
